candidates.change_summary: Remove the betLimit assignment, leaving only the event emission, so betLimit never updates.
Assign a constant value instead of the parameter, so betLimit becomes fixed.
Assign amount + 1, making the stored betLimit differ from the argument.
Remove onlyOwner modifier from AdjustBetAmounts, allowing anyone to change betLimit.
Remove the assignment to difficulty so the state variable is never updated.
Replace 'amount' with a constant so difficulty is always set to 0.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier's require check so anyone can call AdjustDifficulty.
Delete the require statement so that openToPublic is set to true without any access restriction.
Replace 'openToPublic = true' with 'openToPublic = false' so the function sets the opposite value.
Replace require statement with require(false) so the modifier always reverts, preventing OpenToThePublic from ever succeeding.
Replace require(msg.sender == owner) with require(msg.sender != owner) so only non-owners can call functions using this modifier, changing who can call OpenToThePublic.
Delete the require statement so the modifier imposes no access control, allowing anyone to call OpenToThePublic.
Remove the require statement in onlyOwner modifier so that anyone can call AdjustBetAmounts, changing the betLimit state variable without owner restriction.
Replace `betLimit = amount;` with `betLimit = amount + 1;` so that AdjustBetAmounts updates the bet limit to a different value than the input.
Delete the entire function body of AdjustBetAmounts so that betLimit is never updated, leaving its value unchanged from before the call.
